# coolify_server_docker_registries (Data Source)

Lists Docker registry logins Coolify can see on a server. Requires Coolify 4.4 tip (not v4.3.23 and not v4.4-rc.1). Passwords are not returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_server_docker_registries" "example" {
  server_uuid = var.server_uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_uuid` (String) Server UUID.

### Read-Only

- `registries` (Attributes List) Registry rows, including registries used by resources that are not logged in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--registries))

<a id="nestedatt--registries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `registries`

Read-Only:

- `logged_in` (Boolean) Whether the server has saved credentials for this registry.
- `registry` (String) Registry host.
- `source` (String) Where Coolify found the login.
- `username` (String) Saved username. Empty when the server is not logged in.
